themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist parties across North America and Europe face internal strategic friction, midterm campaign challenges, and coalition debates. From Republican candidates attempting to distance themselves or alter messaging in local US races to local candidate balancing in Norway and government exclusion arguments in Sweden, party cohesion remains under pressure.
